newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Tuesday, as stronger CBOT corn futures overnight encouraged local investors to buy, traders said.
Prices were 150 to 260 yen higher, and the benchmark September 1997 contract was up 150 yen at 18,410 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 76,945 lots.
Buying orders from local investors and some brokerage houses supported the market from the opening, the traders said.
"Light technical-based selling capped the topside in late morning, but the market had bullish sentiment today," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.71-1/4 per bushel at 0800 GMT against $3.69-1/2 at Monday's close.
The September contract on the CBOT soybean project A trading system was being traded at $8.16-1/2 at the same time, against $8.17 at Monday's close.
